2026
75 YEARS OF TOPPS BASEBALL
2026 Update Series rounds out the year-long celebration of
the 75th Anniversary of Topps Baseball. Since 1952, Topps
Baseball has defined The Hobby by capturing generations of
stars, rookies, and iconic moments.
THE 2026 FLAGSHIP SERIES CONCLUDES
As the final Flagship release of the year, Update Series
delivers the final 350 cards in the Base Set, capturing
in-season call-ups, players in new uniforms following trades,
and memorable moments from across the season.
ROBUST INSERT LINEUP
Anniversary-inspired inserts and parallels highlight 75 years
of Topps Baseball, including Cover Athletes and 75 Years
autograph themes. Fan-favorite designs such as All Aces,
Heavy Lumber, and Home Field return, while additions
introduced in Series 1 and 2 — including Base Card Rookie 1952
Variations and 1991 Topps Baseball — continue in Update Series.

The insert and autograph columns do not identify exact family eligibility. Preserve all fourteen terms unjoined, including the literal /1, without selecting a family limit.
